title: Hold Fast Till I Come
print: the 1985 book's hymnary.org scan (p585.jpg), each line read off the page at its system and row; the rulings (data/crops/600/rulings.json) put in what the page prints where the base row differs: "other" -> "others" (words, crops p585-171.jpg, judge-583 (Opus, effort max)).

stanzas.text: Sweet promise is given to all who believe;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: "Behold I come quickly Mine own to receive;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Hold fast till I come; the danger is great;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Sleep not as do others; be watchful, and wait."
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: We'll "watch unto prayer" with lamps burning bright;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: He comes to all others a "thief in the night."
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: We know He is near, but know not the day;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: As spring shows that summer is not far away.
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Yes! this is our hope, 'tis built on His word;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: The glorious appearing of Jesus, our Lord;
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Of promises all, it stands as the sum:
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

stanzas.text: "Behold I come quickly, hold fast till I come."
stanzas.from: p585.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

lines.text: "Hold fast till I come;" sweet promise of heaven;
lines.from: p585.jpg system 3, the refrain row (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

lines.text: "The kingdom restored, to you shall be given!"
lines.from: p585.jpg system 4, the refrain row (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

lines.text: "Come, enter My joy, sit down on My throne;
lines.from: p585.jpg system 4, the refrain row (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))

lines.text: Bright crowns are in waiting; hold fast till I come."
lines.from: p585.jpg system 5, the refrain row (placed off the page by from-588 (Opus))
